sections.title: Welcome To TKR College Of Engineering & Technology
sections.content: TKR College of Engineering and Technology – a modern temple of learning, an off shoot of the TKR Educational Society was established in the year 2002 in a sprawling, lush green 20 acre campus at Meerpet, Hyderabad. The college provides a serene and tranquil environment to the students, boosting their mental potential and preparing them in all aspects to face the cut- throat global competition with a smile on the face and emerge victorious.

sections.title: About Us
sections.content: NAAC accredited institution committed to quality technical education. Established in 2002 under the esteemed TKR Educational Society. Sprawling 20-acre lush green campus in Meerpet, Hyderabad. State-of-the-art infrastructure with modern labs and smart classrooms. Highly qualified and experienced faculty across all departments. Strong industry connections for internships and placements. Excellent placement record with top recruiters visiting annually Focus on research, innovation, and entrepreneurship development. Vibrant campus life with cultural, technical, and sports events. Safe, student-friendly campus with hostel, transport, and medical support.
